data.name: Improved Horse Whisperer
data.description: Your understanding of horses goes so deep that you can communicate with them as if you shared a language.

raw_tokens.value: Your understanding of horses goes so deep that you can communicate with them as if you shared a language.

With a successful DC 20 Handle Animal check, you can communicate with a horse as if you were using speak with animals for 1 round. The horse's ability to communicate and take actions is still limited by its intelligence.
